checklist.step: Hold accuracy above 99% before posting
checklist.value: Premium-calculation and code-validity accuracy measured; material errors corrected until accuracy exceeds 99%.

testing.value: Recomputed premium and code checks show accuracy at or above 99%; below-threshold results block posting.

answers.value: A coverholder's bordereau validated for data quality and completeness against the specified field requirements in the binding authority agreement's reporting schema (mandatory fields, formats, code sets, and completeness by risk); scope = one coverholder's monthly bordereau.
The reporting month; validation completed within the 5-business-day window before the bordereau is eligible for posting.

Every mandatory field defined in the BAA reporting schema is present and valid on each risk row (insured, TIV/limit, class, territory, inception, premium, commission); missing or invalid mandatory fields fail the completeness check.
Risk count and premium total on the validated file reconcile to the coverholder's declared control totals; completeness percentage computed per field and reconciled to the field-requirements list.

The validation result (field completeness %, failed rules, reconciliation to declared totals) retained in the EDW run history and SharePoint /UW/DelegatedAuthority/<coverholder>/<YYYYMM>/DQ/ with schema version and timestamp.

Incomplete or invalid rows logged as exceptions with severity and disposition; material completeness gaps block posting and are returned to the coverholder, non-material gaps accepted with a documented note.
All risk rows of the coverholder's monthly bordereau validated against the BAA field-requirements schema (100%, no sampling).

PASS = mandatory-field completeness at or above 99% and all rows reconcile to declared control totals with 0 invalid mandatory values. FAIL = completeness below 99% on any mandatory field or unreconciled control totals.

Rows failing completeness/validity returned to the coverholder for correction and re-validated on resubmission; systemic schema gaps escalated to the Data Quality Analyst and Delegated Authority Manager.
Bordereau reporting month; validation effective as of the load date and re-run on each corrected resubmission.

Field definitions per the BAA bordereau reporting schema mapped in the EDW data dictionary; control totals = risk count and premium sum validated against the coverholder's declared totals and field-level completeness percentages.

checklist.step: Hold completeness above 99% on mandatory fields
checklist.value: Completeness measured per mandatory field against the BAA schema; gaps chased until above the 99% threshold.

testing.value: Mandatory-field completeness at or above 99% on the validated file; below-threshold blocks posting.

checklist.step: Validate against defined data-domain field requirements
checklist.value: Mandatory-field, format and code-set rules for the bordereau domain applied per the BAA reporting schema.

testing.step: Confirm the correct schema was applied
testing.value: The schema/ruleset version used matches the coverholder's BAA reporting requirements; 0 rows validated against a stale schema.

checklist.step: Feed completeness gaps into prevention measures
checklist.value: Recurring missing-field patterns raised with the coverholder as a data-improvement action to prevent repeat gaps.

testing.value: Prior-month recurring completeness gaps have a documented prevention action; recurrence trended down.
